name: confetti-field
prompt: Extension layer that draws falling confetti pieces; density and wind sliders.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote `gen.confetti`, an extension layer of colored rectangles and circles that tumble, flip and sway as they fall over a transparent background. It's not compiled or rendered yet because this run had no live Powermove tools. It assumes the layer renderer provides the shader-layer helpers (iTime, iResolution, hash, rot, sdBox, hsv2rgb), but the API docs don't confirm that. It has keyframeable Density (0–1, default 0.5; how many grid cells get a piece) and Wind (−2 to 2, default 0.3; sideways drift and tilt), with pieces in 4 depth layers.
